query: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM wireguard_network wn WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM device_posture_location dpl WHERE dpl.location_id = wn.id ) AND ( wn.allow_all_groups OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM wireguard_network_allowed_group wnag JOIN "group" g ON g.id = wnag.group_id WHERE wnag.network_id = wn.id AND g.name = ANY($1) ) ) )
